causes.label: demand
causes.quote: The temperature in Sydney reached 40 degrees. This saw demand reach 13 276MW, which was 1400 MW greater than that forecast four hours ahead.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Around 3000 MW of New South Wales generation was not offered into the market on the day.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Eraring unit two 660 Plant problems - shutdown on 19 November

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Planned network outages in New South Wales significantly reduced import capability from Victoria but the impact of these outages was not forecast.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding in both New South Wales and Queensland also contributed to prices exceeding $5000/MWh.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Flows across all interconnectors into New South Wales exceeded the limit for the majority of the time between 9.45 am and 11.20 am.

causes.label: administered_pricing_or_intervention
causes.quote: At 10 am, in response to low reserves in New South Wales, AEMO issued a direction to Delta Electricity to bid Colongra unit one available. The direction was cancelled at 11.35 am. Intervention pricing was applied for the period from 10.10 am to 11.35 am.

interconnectors_named.name: QNI (NSW-QLD)
interconnectors_named.quote: The two interconnectors between New South Wales and Queensland were constrained.

interconnectors_named.name: VIC-NSW
interconnectors_named.quote: Planned network outages in New South Wales significantly reduced import capability from Victoria

intervals.quote: the spot price in New South Wales and Queensland exceeded $5000/MWh for 10 trading intervals in total
